speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your condition, could you tell me if you have noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or if your urine has become dark? Also, have you experienced any abdominal pain or swelling recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any pale or clay-colored stools, or experienced unexplained weight loss? I would also like to know if you have had any recent fevers or night sweats.
